stem.text: Which diagram shows a correct ring structure and named nucleic acid base?

A.alt: Skeletal drawing of a single six-membered ring with no atoms labelled (option A).

B.alt: Skeletal drawing of a six-membered ring fused to a five-membered ring, with no atoms labelled (option B).

C.alt: Skeletal drawing of a six-membered ring fused to a five-membered ring, with no atoms labelled (option C).

D.alt: Skeletal drawing of a single six-membered ring with no atoms labelled (option D).
